title: Vinyume vya Vitenzi na Vielezi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na hisia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives verbs and adverbs of the opposite meaning (nunua/uza, mapema/kuchelewa) and uses them in a passage.

board.say: Kinyume chake ni nini, na wakati uleule?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Alilia" and two adverb pairs.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha fungua ni kipi?" Kwa nini "nunua" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Kinyume cha polepole ni kipi?" Kwa nini "chini" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Kinyume cha nunua ni kipi?" Kwa nini "pika" si jibu sahihi?
Kuna neno moja lenye maana kinyume?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume ni neno lingine lenye maana kinyume: polepole.
